anchor.semantic_hook: Spun talk becomes a continuous ribbon of empty speech bubbles wound around a spindle.
anchor.setting: An empty conversation salon contains armchairs, a low table, and a wooden spinning station. At its center, a spindle as tall as the ceiling is wrapped in one continuous ribbon of blank speech-bubble shapes. The remaining furniture has ordinary proportions.
anchor.absurd_element: a ceiling-high spindle wound with a ribbon of empty speech bubbles

variations.scene_adjust: a plain podium, ballot box, and several sealed empty gift boxes

inserts.action: offers a flower and an ingratiating smile toward an empty armchair while discreetly hiding crossed fingers behind his back

variations.scene_adjust: a flower, a cup of sweets, and a deck of trick cards beside the spinning station
